_readme: Which orb a shard makes, for pricing a shard the exchange cannot price.
The Currency Exchange cannot quote finer than one chaos on the chaos side, so a bulk
shard trade is recorded at one chaos each and a single trade sets the price. That is
how Alteration Shard came back at 1c against an Orb of Alteration at 0.12c - 167x its
real worth, on one trade in twenty-four hours. The orb is the answer: it trades in the
hundreds of thousands and twenty shards make one.
classify.ts trusts a shard's own quote only when the shard traded at least as much as
its orb did. Volume is the whole test - not PoeWatch's lowConfidence flag, which it
left off Transmutation Shard at 1c against an orb at 0.005379c. Nothing here is
expected to pass - a shard market is never busier than the orb market - which is the
point: the shard's quote is the one that has to earn its place, not the orb's.
Every shard in the game is twenty to the orb, so 'per' is one number rather than a
column. It is here rather than in classify.ts so a shard that arrives at some other
A shard the league does not price is ignored rather than an error, the same as
max-stacks.json. Fracturing and Divine Shard are listed because GGG names them, not
because either has been seen on the exchange.
